data.case_title: Suspicious "energy refund" letter demanding an upfront fee
data.explanation: This letter shows classic signs of an advance-fee scam: a surprise refund that only gets paid out after you first send money, a tight deadline, and threats that the "claim" disappears if you miss it. Genuine German refunds — from tax offices, energy suppliers, or consumer agencies — are never conditional on you paying a fee first, and certainly not to a foreign (Cypriot) bank account. We strongly recommend not transferring any money and not replying with personal or bank details. If you want to double-check, contact your real energy supplier directly or ask a consumer protection center (Verbraucherzentrale) or the police before acting on this letter.

items.title: Requested 'processing fee' before refund payout
items.action: Do not transfer this fee without independently verifying the sender first — the letter asks for €49.90 to be sent to the stated account by this date.
items.consequence: The letter claims the €612.00 refund entitlement is permanently forfeited if the fee is not paid in time.
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.

data.summary: A sender calling itself "Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie", based in Nicosia, Cyprus, tells Johanna Beispielacker she is owed a €612.00 refund for energy costs from 2023–2025, but demands an upfront "processing fee" of €49.90 be paid by 27 November 2026 to a Cypriot IBAN before the refund is released.
warnings: This letter has strong characteristics of an advance-fee scam: it asks for an upfront payment before a promised refund can be paid out, and threatens that the claim is permanently lost if you miss a short deadline.
The requested payment account (IBAN) is in Cyprus, which is highly unusual for a refund related to German energy bills.
The sender's email domain ('rueckerstattung-energie.example') is a placeholder/example domain and does not correspond to a known, verifiable company.

There is no officially recognized German authority or consumer body named 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie'; do not send money or personal/bank data in response to this letter without independent verification.
